$comment: Iris runtime config — Website Control. See iris/IRIS_CONTRACT.md before editing.
role: Marketing & IT — listings, photos, the public site

$mode_values.standalone: Iris takes orders from her own command sources (email, control panel). Website Control runs as its own app. This is the current state while Foundation Layer is being built.
$mode_values.managed: Iris takes orders ONLY from the Chief of Staff. Every local command source is stood down. Foundation Layer owns intent; Iris owns execution.

email.$note: ONLY honoured in standalone mode. Ignored entirely when mode=managed.
email.$mailbox_note: 'auto' = whatever mailbox the Gmail connector is authenticated as. Target is manager@echmanagement.services — the business inbox. Never hardcode an address here; resolve at runtime and report which was used.

control_panel.$note: Reserved. A direct UI for Website Control as a standalone app — same instruction envelope, no email round-trip.

chief_of_staff.$note: Set enabled=true and mode=managed together when Foundation Layer plugs in. Iris then accepts only signed envelopes from TARS.

autonomy.$note: Standalone: reversible changes (status/price/copy/photos/reorder) publish immediately, each as its own commit. Create/remove wait for human confirmation. When mode=managed this MUST drop to propose-only to match Foundation Layer's L1 gate — FL has no auto-commit branch anywhere and Iris must not be the exception.

publish_target.$sole_writer: Iris is the ONLY writer to the listing region of this repo. Anything else touching the LISTINGS:START/END markers is a conflict — see IRIS_CONTRACT.md §5.
